selected_codec_detail.selection: MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported preference order; first supported wins

chunk_target_detail.note: The stop tail can be shorter than the target; the first chunk carries the container header. Design §7.4 suggests a 2-5 s target; 3 s was probed.

continuity_detail.summary: Chunks are container fragments, not independent files. Reassembly requires chunk 0 (header) plus ascending sequence order. The probe server verifies sequence continuity and rejects a headerless first chunk instead of guessing.
continuity_detail.out_of_order_reassembly: Upload order 2,1,0 reconstructed byte-identically to the browser-side concatenation for both tracks.

video_track_detail.policy: getDisplayMedia is called with {video:true, audio:true}; video:false is never assumed. A video track may be required by the browser to obtain a share, but its frames must never be encoded, uploaded, stored, or logged.
video_track_detail.observed: A 320x180 5 fps canvas video track stayed live for the whole synthetic recording and was ended with the audio tracks at stop.
video_track_detail.encoder_stream_guard: capture.mjs refuses any encoder stream containing a video track

epoch_anchor_rule: A refresh or re-authorization starts a new capture_epoch_id. Within one epoch, both audio tracks use the same monotonic clock and every segment records start_ms/end_ms relative to that epoch anchor. Across epochs, preserve the real interruption interval and clock uncertainty by combining the server manifest, the meeting start time, and the resume-time anchor; never splice a new page's performance.now() as if the audio were continuous, and never compress an interruption into seamless audio.

epoch_anchor_detail.same_epoch_clock: one monotonic clock shared by mic and system tracks
epoch_anchor_detail.cross_epoch: preserve real gap and clock uncertainty; use server manifest + meeting start + resume anchor
epoch_anchor_detail.reason: No refresh, re-authorization, or recovery scenario was run; only the design rule is recorded.

supported_combinations.share_target: canvas.captureStream(5) 320x180 + synthetic WebAudio track; not a real tab or desktop share
supported_combinations.output_route: synthetic WebAudio destination; no real speaker or headphone route
supported_combinations.audio_track_present: yes (synthetic 440 Hz mic and 660 Hz display audio)
